import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println(app(n, m));
    }

    // Extended Euclidean algorithm (not used in main, but included for completeness)
    public static int[] egcd(int a, int b) {
        int r0 = a, r1 = b;
        int s0 = 1, s1 = 0;
        int t0 = 0, t1 = 1;
        while (r1 != 0) {
            int q = r0 / r1;
            int r2 = r0 - q * r1;
            int s2 = s0 - q * s1;
            int t2 = t0 - q * t1;
            r0 = r1; r1 = r2;
            s0 = s1; s1 = s2;
            t0 = t1; t1 = t2;
        }
        return new int[]{r0, s0};
    }

    // Compute product from k+1 to n modulo M
    public static int[] tf(int n, int M) {
        int[] C = new int[n + 1];
        C[n] = 1;
        for (int k = n - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            C[k] = (int)(((long)C[k + 1] * (k + 1)) % M);
            if (C[k] == 0) break;
        }
        return C;
    }

    public static int app(int n, int M) {
        // K is a list of 2D arrays
        List<int[][]> K = new ArrayList<>();
        // K[0] = [[1]]
        int[][] first = new int[1][1];
        first[0][0] = 1;
        K.add(first);

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            int[][] Ki = K.get(i);
            int ni = Ki.length; // number of rows in Ki
            int rows = ni + i + 1;
            int cols = i + 2;
            int[][] Ki_ = new int[rows][cols];
            for (int j = 0; j < ni; j++) {
                int[] Kij = Ki[j];
                for (int k = 0; k < Kij.length; k++) {
                    int v = Kij[k];
                    for (int h = 0; h <= i; h++) {
                        Ki_[j + h][k] = (Ki_[j + h][k] + v) % M;
                    }
                    Ki_[j + i + 1][i + 1] = (Ki_[j + i + 1][i + 1] + v) % M;
                }
            }
            K.add(Ki_);
        }

        int[] C = tf(n, M);
        int s = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int[][] Ki = K.get(i);
            int ni = Ki.length;
            int mi = Ki[0].length;
            int[][] Si = new int[ni][mi];
            // Fill Si from right to left
            for (int j = 0; j < ni; j++) {
                Si[j][mi - 1] = Ki[j][mi - 1];
                for (int k = mi - 2; k >= 0; k--) {
                    Si[j][k] = (Ki[j][k] + Si[j][k + 1]) % M;
                }
            }
            // Prefix sums over rows
            for (int j = 1; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < mi; k++) {
                    Si[j][k] = (Si[j][k] + Si[j - 1][k]) % M;
                }
            }

            int si = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < mi - 1; k++) {
                    si = (int)((si + (long)Ki[j][k] * Si[j - 1][k + 1]) % M);
                }
            }

            int c = C[i + 1];
            si = (int)(((long)si * c) % M);
            s = (s + si) % M;
        }
        return s;
    }
}
